name: zclass_node_update_display_instance
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeUpdateDisplayInstance rebuilds display-instance bounds when a DI is present, sets the display-instance flag, and clears the flag when no DI is attached.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass node-update/source-cluster pass.
